name: rka
description: Research Knowledge Agent (RKA) — Claude Code plugin distribution from the local clone of the RKA repository. Add this marketplace via /plugin marketplace add <path-to-cloned-rka-repo>, then install the plugin via /plugin install rka@rka.

plugins.name: rka
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to a local RKA backend for provenance-tracked research workflows. Provides ~110 RKA MCP tools, three role skills (Brain, Executor, PI), five RKA-side slash commands (/rka-status, /rka-search, /rka-pending, /rka-set-project, /rka-setup-claude-desktop), and a SessionStart hook that pings the backend on every new session. The agentic-branch distribution also ships the orchestrator surface: a second MCP server (rka-orchestrator, 10 tools) that drives a LangGraph Brain⇄Executor⇄PI workflow against RKA missions, plus an orchestrator-pi skill and three slash commands (/orchestrator-start, /orchestrator-inbox, /orchestrator-status). Activates when user mentions RKA, research knowledge, knowledge graph, research notes, decisions, missions, journal entries, evidence clusters, citing literature, organizing research, tracking provenance, orchestrator, LangGraph, agentic workflows, or PI ratification.
